occupations.label: Doctor
occupations.flavor: Years in a practice or field clinic left them with a steady hand and an instinct to heal.

occupations.label: Soldier
occupations.flavor: Service — voluntary or otherwise — drilled them for violence. They carry that order into chaos.

occupations.label: Farmer
occupations.flavor: The land was teacher, employer, and home. They still feel the seasons in their bones.

occupations.label: Engineer
occupations.flavor: Systems made sense to them when people didn't. Now systems are all that's left.

occupations.label: Teacher
occupations.flavor: They shaped minds for a world that no longer exists. They haven't stopped trying.

occupations.label: Merchant
occupations.flavor: They measured every situation in terms of exchange. Old habit. Still useful.

occupations.label: Pilot
occupations.flavor: Altitude gives perspective. They see distance others can't — and plan accordingly.

occupations.label: Artist
occupations.flavor: They made beauty in a world that rarely noticed. They still believe it matters.

occupations.label: Cleric
occupations.flavor: Faith is not certainty. They learned that long before the end came.

occupations.label: Mechanic
occupations.flavor: If it's broken, they'll fix it. If it can't be fixed, they'll make something new from the parts.

life_experiences.label: Combat Veteran
life_experiences.flavor: Saw real fighting. Some of it stayed with them.

life_experiences.label: First Aid Trained
life_experiences.flavor: A workplace certification. Now worth more than a degree.

life_experiences.label: Wilderness Survivor
life_experiences.flavor: Lost in the backcountry once. Found their way back alone.

life_experiences.label: Community Organiser
life_experiences.flavor: Called meetings. Got people to show up. Got things done.

life_experiences.label: Plague Survivor
life_experiences.flavor: Watched the sickness take others. Came through the other side changed.

life_experiences.label: Disaster Refugee
life_experiences.flavor: Left everything behind once before. They know how to start over.

backstory_templates.label: Military Medic
backstory_templates.defining_moment: Kept a squad alive under fire with nothing but gauze and nerve.
backstory_templates.pre_war_life: Served a tour as a combat medic. Returned home with a useful trade and unwanted memories.
backstory_templates.reason_for_survival: Too many people still need what I know.

backstory_templates.label: Rural Engineer
backstory_templates.defining_moment: Rigged a water pump from scrap after the floods. Entire village drank because of it.
backstory_templates.pre_war_life: Infrastructure consultant for remote communities. Always travelling, never settled.
backstory_templates.reason_for_survival: Someone has to keep the lights on.

backstory_templates.label: Schoolteacher
backstory_templates.defining_moment: Kept thirty children calm in a gymnasium for six days during the first evacuation.
backstory_templates.pre_war_life: Primary school teacher. Known for patience and homemade biscuits on Fridays.
backstory_templates.reason_for_survival: The children need someone who still believes in tomorrow.

backstory_templates.label: Plague Merchant
backstory_templates.defining_moment: Survived a quarantine zone by trading medical supplies for passage.
backstory_templates.pre_war_life: Supply chain manager for a pharmaceutical distributor. Knows where things go and how to move them.
backstory_templates.reason_for_survival: Information and inventory. Both of which I still have.
